job.title: Legal Assistant - Part Time
job.description:
About the Firm
Our client is a leading international law firm with a well-established presence in Sydney and across major markets worldwide. Known locally as a genuine market leader, the firm has built a reputation for its supportive, high-performing culture, offering a professional and collegiate environment where business services and legal support staff are highly valued. With a strong focus on inclusion, wellbeing and flexible ways of working, the firm invests heavily in the growth of its people and prides itself on being a genuinely great place to build a long-term career.

The Role
We are recruiting an experienced Legal Assistant to support the Financial Services practice within a well-regarded Corporate team in Sydney. This part-time role is offered on a parental leave cover contract until September 2027, as part of a job share with another experienced Legal Assistant, supporting two Partners and two Senior Associates.

Working days are fixed at Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, with Wednesday being a crossover day with your job share partner. This suits a confident, organised Legal Assistant who enjoys being a trusted right-hand to senior lawyers in a fast-paced, high-performing team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Managing diaries, inboxes and workflows, and coordinating day-to-day administrative matters
  • Preparing and managing correspondence, documents and matter files
  • Coordinating meetings, calls, events and travel arrangements
  • Liaising confidently with clients and internal stakeholders
  • Managing billing, including pre-bills, edits, finalisation and cost reporting
  • Monitoring deadlines and following up on outstanding actions
  • Collaborating with other Legal Assistants and Administrative Assistants across the Corporate group
  • Contributing ideas for more efficient ways of working, including technology and AI tools
Candidate Requirements
  • Demonstrated experience as a Legal Assistant or senior legal support professional in a legal or professional services environment
  • Proven experience supporting senior stakeholders, with sound judgement and discretion
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Experience with billing, reporting and matter management systems
  • Previous job share experience desirable but not essential
  • A service-oriented mindset and willingness to mentor junior team members
Why Apply
Join a high-performing, market-leading practice within a truly international firm, working alongside supportive senior lawyers. The firm invests heavily in its people, offering structured development, mentoring, a strong focus on wellbeing, and additional benefits including wellbeing and home office allowances.

About Barratt Galvin
Established in 2014, Barratt Galvin is a specialist legal recruitment consultancy focused on private practice legal recruitment. Laura Barratt, our founder, has been recruiting throughout Australia, the Middle East and the UK since 2005, building deep market knowledge and long-standing relationships across each region.

We partner with leading international and regional law firms to recruit Lawyers, Legal Assistants, Business Development, Marketing, and HR professionals. Recognised for our strength in international law firm recruitment, we regularly advise on moves between the markets within which we recruit.

With strong Sydney and broader Australian market connections, we support both local career progression and international relocation for those seeking opportunities in the Middle East, UK, or beyond.

Barratt Galvin delivers specialist insight, discretion, and access to exclusive opportunities across Australian and global legal markets.

job.title: Executive Assistant | Riyadh
job.description:
About the Firm

This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading international law firm at a pivotal moment in its regional growth. With a well-established presence in the Middle East spanning more than two decades, the firm has built a strong reputation for advising on high-profile, multi-jurisdictional matters across the region. 

The firm recently expanded into Saudi Arabia, opening two new offices in the Kingdom. Its Saudi practice advises across corporate, transport, marine, energy and infrastructure, construction, litigation, private wealth and finance. This is a firm that combines genuine international reach with deep local knowledge, and its Saudi Arabia presence represents a significant and well-supported long-term investment.

The Role

This is a newly created position, reflecting the continued growth of the firm's Riyadh office. The successful candidate will support two Partners plus team, covering Corporate, Energy and Infrastructure. This role encompasses a broad range of administrative, financial and business development responsibilities. The working week is Sunday to Thursday, with hybrid working available: three days in the office and two from home.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage complex diaries across multiple time zones, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring meetings run smoothly
  • Arrange international travel, visas and itineraries in compliance with firm policy
  • Prepare meeting materials, track actions and ensure timely follow-up
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external clients, supporting business development activities including research, pitch preparation and event coordination
  • Maintain and update the CRM system to ensure client information is accurate and current
  • Oversee new client and matter onboarding, ensuring compliance requirements are met and documentation is completed accurately
  • Coordinate billing processes using Aderant, including generating prebills, preparing invoices and attending WIP and credit control meetings
  • Act as gatekeeper for fee earners, managing correspondence with discretion and drafting high-quality documents and communications
  • Provide general office operations support and liaise with regional finance and BD teams, contributing to the smooth running of the office during its current growth phase
Candidate Requirements
  • Saudi National
  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or Legal Assistant, ideally within a law firm or professional services environment
  • Excellent academic background
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills and experience using a billing system such as Aderant
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen
  • Fully bilingual in Arabic and English, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels
  • Professional and confident, with a demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with partners and clients
  • Excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities under pressure
  • A collaborative, can-do approach with a willingness to take initiative and contribute to a growing office
Why Apply

The Riyadh office is at an early and dynamic stage of its development, and this role offers genuine visibility and the chance to make a real contribution to how the office operates day to day. You will work closely with two Partners in a small, close-knit team, with early responsibility and the support of a well-resourced international platform behind you.

The firm offers a strong benefits package including:
  • Competitive salary and discretionary annual performance bonus
  • Hybrid working: 3 days in office, 2 days from home
  • Comprehensive international private medical cover for you, your spouse and up to three children
  • 25 days annual leave, plus Hajj and Umrah leave for Muslims and Christmas day for those who celebrate
  • Enhanced parental leave, including maternity, paternity, adoption and fertility provisions
  • Interest-free rent loan advance, including 100% of first year's rent for those relocating
  • 24/7 employee wellbeing assistance programme and funded external counselling sessions
  • Study leave and firm support for professional development and further qualifications
  • Access to legal technology and generative AI training and tools
About Barratt Galvin

Established in 2014, Barratt Galvin is a specialist legal recruitment consultancy focused on the Middle East legal market. Laura Barratt, our founder, has been recruiting across the region since 2007, bringing close to two decades of expertise and long-standing relationships with law firms throughout Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Jeddah, and Doha. We partner with leading international and regional law firms to recruit Legal Assistants, Business Development, Marketing, and HR professionals. We are recognised for our strength in Middle East law firm recruitment and regularly advise on private practice opportunities and broader international law firm business services recruitment across the GCC. With strong Australian market connections, we support both regional career progression and international relocation. Barratt Galvin delivers specialist insight, discretion, and access to exclusive opportunities across the Middle East legal sector.
